verdict.rationale: LangGraph explicitly documents multi-agent orchestration patterns (handoffs, subagents, custom workflows embedding other patterns as nodes) with graph-based state management, checkpointers for persistence across agents, interrupts for human-in-the-loop handoffs, and streaming to observe multi-agent execution; community corroboration confirms nodes can be arbitrary functions/agents and cycles/parallelism are supported via Pregel/BSP. Missing for 10: no hands-on independent benchmark of a concrete multi-agent 'crew' example, and some community comments note persistence/streaming require developer-side implementation work rather than being fully turnkey.
